correction: build.clean patterns are pathlib globs, and pathlib's dir/** matches directories only, so a pattern such as build/** deletes nothing while reporting removed 0 file(s) and a stale artifact then survives into the next build. Write dir/**/* (or name the files explicitly), and read removed 0 file(s) as a signal to check the pattern rather than as proof of a clean tree.
